right_atrium.name: Right atrium
right_atrium.description: Receives oxygen-poor blood from the body

left_atrium.name: Left atrium
left_atrium.description: Receives oxygen-rich blood from the lungs

right_ventricle.name: Right ventricle
right_ventricle.description: Pumps oxygen-poor blood to the lungs

left_ventricle.name: Left ventricle
left_ventricle.description: Pumps oxygen-rich blood to the whole body

aorta.name: Aorta
aorta.description: Biggest artery — carries blood to the body

svc.name: Superior vena cava
svc.description: Oxygen-poor blood from the upper body

ivc.name: Inferior vena cava
ivc.description: Oxygen-poor blood from the lower body

coronary_arteries.name: Coronary arteries
coronary_arteries.description: Vessels that feed the heart muscle itself

coronary_veins.name: Coronary veins
coronary_veins.description: Vessels that drain the heart muscle
